source_scope: Fixed R1 local code/configuration, not current online main

probe_groups.A: single reference / content / continuous condition boundary

f5.title: F5-TTS v1 Base
f5.en: Identity information can enter through reference Mel, text conditioning and the joint DiT input.
f5.zh: 没有独立说话人向量；参考Mel、文本与当前状态共同进入DiT。
f5.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

qwen3.title: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base
qwen3.en: A 2048-value speaker vector, reference codec embeddings and text projection jointly enter the full ICL prompt. Reference codes also enter final decoding.
qwen3.zh: 2048维说话人向量、参考语音码连续嵌入与文本投影共同组成full ICL提示；参考码也进入最终解码。
qwen3.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

openvoice.title: OpenVoice V2
openvoice.en: Source and target timbre vectors modulate different flow directions. With zero_g enabled, target g does not enter the posterior encoder or waveform generator.
openvoice.zh: 源与目标音色向量分别调制正向和逆向Flow；zero_g配置下target g不进入后验编码器或波形生成器。
openvoice.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

cosy3.title: CosyVoice 3
cosy3.en: The reference provides LM prompt codes, Flow reference Mel and a speaker condition. Flow produces target Mel and HiFT reconstructs speech.
cosy3.zh: 参考录音通过LM提示码、Flow参考Mel和说话人条件多路进入生成。
cosy3.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

chatterbox.title: Chatterbox Turbo
chatterbox.en: T3 and S3Gen use different reference packages. The T3 intervention targets a joint speaker and speech prefix, not a single speaker vector.
chatterbox.zh: T3与S3Gen有不同参考包；T3干预点是说话人投影与173行参考码组成的联合前缀。
chatterbox.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

seedvc.title: Seed-VC V2
seedvc.en: A style vector, reference continuous codes and reference Mel jointly condition CFM. The narrow and AR style-conversion branch is inactive in this configuration.
seedvc.zh: style、参考连续码和参考Mel共同进入CFM；narrow/AR风格分支在本配置中未启用。
seedvc.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

voxcpm2.title: VoxCPM2
voxcpm2.en: Isolated and continuation reference latents have different context and padding. Semantic and residual language-model projections feed a local DiT that generates audio patches.
voxcpm2.zh: 隔离参考与续写参考潜变量具有不同上下文和padding；语义/残差LM投影进入局部DiT逐patch生成。
voxcpm2.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

fish_s2.title: Fish Speech S2
fish_s2.en: Reference audio becomes ten discrete code streams. Slow and fast transformers generate new codes; post-transformer and DAC reconstruct the waveform.
fish_s2.zh: 参考音频量化为10组离散码；慢/快Transformer生成新码，post-Transformer与DAC重建波形。
fish_s2.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21

freevc.title: FreeVC
freevc.en: The target speaker vector conditions both reverse Flow and Generator. R1 could not load the model, so all six intervention sites remain unexecuted.
freevc.zh: 目标g同时调制逆向Flow与Generator；本轮加载失败，6个位置未执行、效应均未知。
freevc.source: VC_module_attribution_R1_完整实验报告.pdf, fixed local implementation, 2026-11-21
